chapter: Instruments, own band and the Eureka
title: Saxophones and E flat trumpets in brass bands; funeral work
summary: Brass bands of his time used E-flat and B-flat trumpets and no saxophones; he also describes railroad work taking care of the dead.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line
